Before: a bowl of cornflakes (~40 g, ~150 kcal), a milk bottle (~200 ml whole milk, ~130 kcal), and a latte (~250 ml, ~120 kcal).

After: the cornflakes are all eaten. The milk bottle has about 30 ml left, so roughly 170 ml was consumed (~110 kcal, ~175 g). The latte is almost gone with a thin film left, so about 230 ml was consumed (~110 kcal, ~230 g).

Totals: cornflakes 40 g and 150 kcal, milk 175 g and 110 kcal, latte 230 g and 110 kcal. That gives about 370 kcal and about 445 g.
